fluff.overview: The Manei Domini field cybernetically enhanced infantry whose augmentations place them well beyond the capability of any conventional soldier, blurring the line between human combatant and war machine. Domini motorized formations use light vehicles to extend their operational reach while retaining the cybernetic advantages that make each trooper a force multiplier. The vehicles serve primarily as transport to deliver augmented soldiers where they are needed most. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
